cards.title: Team / Group
cards.subtitle: Which team should own this ticket?
cards.instructions: Which team should handle this customer message?

criteria.sales: Pricing, plans, upgrades, quotes, new purchases, or prospective customers
criteria.service: Technical problems, bugs, outages, how-to questions, or account/support issues
criteria.customer_success: Onboarding, adoption, renewals, churn risk, or relationship and account-growth topics

cards.title: Topic
cards.subtitle: What is the ticket about?
cards.instructions: What is this customer message primarily about?

criteria.bug: A defect, error, crash, or something not working as expected
criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds, payment methods, or pricing
criteria.how_to: A usage or how-to question about existing functionality
criteria.feature_request: A request for new functionality or an improvement
criteria.account: Login, password, access, permissions, or account settings
criteria.other: Anything that does not fit the categories above

cards.title: Ticket Type
cards.subtitle: First contact or a follow-up?
cards.instructions: Is this a brand-new ticket or a follow-up on an existing/previous issue?

criteria.new: A first-time report with no reference to prior contact
criteria.follow_up: References a previous message, ticket, agent, or an unresolved earlier issue

cards.title: Priority
cards.subtitle: How urgently does this need a response?
cards.instructions: How urgent or time-sensitive is resolving this ticket?

cards.title: Customer Mood
cards.subtitle: Emotional tone of the message
cards.instructions: What is the emotional tone of the customer in this message?

cards.title: Refund Request
cards.subtitle: Is the customer asking for money back?
cards.instructions: Is the customer requesting a refund, chargeback, or their money back?

criteria.true: Explicitly or implicitly asking for a refund, chargeback, cancellation with money back, or reimbursement

cards.title: Churn Risk
cards.subtitle: Is the customer at risk of leaving?
cards.instructions: Is the customer signaling they might cancel, downgrade, or switch to a competitor?

criteria.true: Threatens to cancel, unsubscribe, downgrade, leave, or move to a competitor
criteria.false: No sign of leaving or dissatisfaction with the relationship
